user.title: Add a recuperator
user.description: Pick the two fans and the two temperature probes. The inside probe sits at the basement end of the core, the outside probe at the outdoor end. Breathing starts switched off; turn on the Breathing switch when ready.

init.title: Recuperator
init.description: What would you like to change?

settings.title: Recuperator settings
settings.description: All settings take effect within a second, without restarting the cycle. They are also available as entities on the device page.

data_description.reset_to_defaults: Ignore the values above and restore these settings to their defaults. The diagram colours and replay settings are kept.

data_description.recovery_percent: End a phase once the far probe has closed this much of the gap. Low (10-25%): switch as soon as the far end of the core starts to change, best heat recovery, shorter phases. High (80%+): let the core fill up, longer phases, more heat lost at the end of each phase.
data_description.min_phase_seconds: No exhaust or intake phase ends before this, whatever the probes say.
data_description.max_phase_seconds: No exhaust or powered intake phase runs longer than this (up to 24 hours).
data_description.pause_seconds: Both fans off for this long between phases, so a fan stops before the other starts.

fine_tuning.name: Fine-tuning
fine_tuning.description: When the core counts as settled. Rarely needs changing.

data_description.settle_seconds: The far probe counts as settled if it moved less than the settle change over this many seconds.
data_description.settle_delta: How little the far probe may move during the settle window to count as settled (ended early because the core has done all it will).

protection.name: Draught protection
protection.description: Keeping the air coming into the room comfortable.

data_description.max_supply_drop: During intake the inside probe reads the air entering the room. Once the minimum phase has passed, the intake ends if that air is more than this much colder than the room (the basement temperature from the last exhaust). Works in any season: it follows the room, so a cold room still breathes.
data_description.min_supply_temperature: Optional hard floor: the intake also ends if the air entering the room drops below this temperature. -30 (the default) means off. Only set it if there is a temperature the room must never see, e.g. near water pipes.

cold.name: Cold weather
cold.description: Limits that apply at or below the cold threshold.

data_description.cold_threshold: At or below this outdoor temperature, the cold-weather limits apply.
data_description.cold_intake_max_seconds: In cold weather, intake never runs longer than this. Allow enough time for fresh air to get through the ducting (several minutes with long hoses or slow fans); Maximum supply drop protects the room.
data_description.cold_exhaust_extra_seconds: In cold weather, exhaust runs at least as long as the last intake and at most this much longer (no upper limit after an intake the phase limit cut short).

timed.name: Timed breathing
timed.description: Fixed phase lengths: in Timed mode, in mild weather, and while a probe is offline.

data_description.timed_exhaust_seconds: Length of each exhaust phase in Timed mode, and whenever the probes cannot be used (inside and outside too similar, or a probe unavailable).
data_description.timed_intake_seconds: Length of each intake phase in Timed mode, and whenever the probes cannot be used. The cold intake limit still applies; a passive intake uses Passive intake maximum instead.
data_description.similar_band: If the two probes differ by less than this when a phase starts, that phase is timed instead, using Timed exhaust or Timed intake (nothing to recover, e.g. mild weather or hose disconnected).

phase_balance.name: Phase balance
phase_balance.description: Keep one phase shorter than the other.

data_description.phase_limit: Keep one phase shorter than the other. Limited intake: an intake never lasts longer than Phase limit share of the exhaust before it. Limited exhaust: the other way round. Minimum phase still applies, room protection can still end an intake sooner, and in cold weather the cold exhaust rule wins over a limited exhaust. Passive intakes are not limited, and Limited exhaust sits out the exhaust after an intake that ran the core out of heat (so the breaths cannot shrink one after another).
data_description.phase_limit_percent: With a phase limit on: how long the limited phase may run, as a share of the other phase's last length (100% = no longer than it).

drying.name: Drying
drying.description: While the room is too humid.

data_description.drying: Lean towards exhaust while the room is more humid than the target humidity. Needs a room humidity sensor (Configure, Room and outdoor sensors).
data_description.drying_exhaust_only: Let drying switch to Exhaust only when the room is very humid (Exhaust-only humidity).
data_description.target_humidity: With Drying on: above this room humidity, breathing leans towards exhaust.
data_description.drying_band: How far above the target humidity drying reaches its strongest lean (the drying intake share).
data_description.drying_min_intake_share: The shortest intakes get while drying, as a share of the exhaust before them.
data_description.drying_exhaust_only_humidity: With 'Drying may run exhaust only' on: at or above this room humidity, run Exhaust only until the room is 3 % below it again.
data_description.drying_min_room_temperature: Drying stands down while the room is colder than this, so it never chills the room in winter.

passive.name: Passive intake
passive.description: Intakes with the intake fan off.

data_description.passive_intake: Intake phases run with the intake fan off: after each exhaust, the room refills on its own through the core, for up to the passive intake maximum. The exhaust fan works as usual. Passive inflow shows whether air really came in.
data_description.passive_intake_max_seconds: With passive intake on, the longest an intake phase may last (it can end sooner by the usual rules: recovery target, settled, supply drop, cold limits).
data_description.passive_flow_delta: During a passive intake, the inside probe moving this much towards the outdoor temperature counts as air flowing in.

colours.title: Diagram colours
colours.description: Each stop is a temperature and the colour shown at that temperature; colours in between are blended. Pick a colour with the colour box, clear a temperature to remove its stop, or fill in an empty row to add one. The order does not matter: stops are sorted by temperature. At least two stops are needed.

data_description.reset_colours: Ignore the rows above and restore the weather-service colour scale.

link.title: Linked unit
link.description:
A second unit that breathes together with this one, moving air the opposite way so the house stays balanced: while this recuperator exhausts, the linked unit takes air in, and while this one takes air in, the linked unit exhausts.

A full recuperator or a single fan follows this recuperator's phases, pauses and mode. A synced recuperator is another Recuperator you have added, with its own probes, sensors and settings: the two switch together, as the sync rule says. Breathing and Mode stay separate on each, so they only keep in step while both are breathing in Automatic or Timed. Saving restarts the recuperator (and the synced one), unless only the sync rule changed.

data_description.link_type: Full recuperator: a second biphasic unit with its own exhaust and intake fans. Intake fan only: runs while this recuperator exhausts. Exhaust fan only: runs while this recuperator takes air in. Synced recuperator: another Recuperator, with its own probes, that switches together with this one.
data_description.link_exhaust_switch: Needed for a full recuperator or an exhaust fan. Ignored for an intake fan only.
data_description.link_intake_switch: Needed for a full recuperator or an intake fan. Ignored for an exhaust fan only.
data_description.link_entry: Needed for a synced recuperator: the other Recuperator. It is linked back to this one when you save. Ignored for the other kinds.
data_description.sync_rule: For a synced recuperator: when the pair switches. Either is done: as soon as one unit's phase is done, so phases can end a little early. Both are done: once both are; the first keeps its fan running until then. Average: once the two units' progress towards their recovery targets, averaged, gets there. A lead rule: only the lead unit's probes decide. Room protection and the cold limits on either unit always switch the pair.

replay.title: Replay
replay.description: Used by the Create button on the Replay device. Running the Create replay action with values saves them here too.

data_description.replay_hours: How much history the Create replay button replays. Also saved from the last Create replay action.
data_description.replay_playback_seconds: How long one loop of the replay lasts.
data_description.replay_frames: Number of frames (0 = one per minute of history, 60 to 1440).
data_description.replay_linked: Draw the synced recuperator too, under this one, in the same replay.
data_description.replay_gif: Also save each replay as an animated GIF next to the SVG, for sharing. A GIF has at most 200 frames; fewer Replay frames make a smaller file.

sensors.title: Room and outdoor sensors
sensors.description: All optional. With them, the recuperator knows the room and outdoor conditions all the time instead of learning them from the probes between breaths. Saving restarts the recuperator. Clear a field to stop using that sensor.

data_description.room_temperature_sensor: Used as the room temperature for Maximum supply drop, Similar temperatures, Heat recovery and the drying room minimum. Place it at the same height as the core's room end: a sensor higher up, where the air is warmer, makes intakes end sooner.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: A temperature sensor or a weather entity. Decides cold weather and Similar temperatures, and is the outdoor reference for Heat recovery. When a phase has recovered is still judged by the probes, which read the air actually reaching the core.
data_description.outdoor_humidity_sensor: A humidity sensor or a weather entity. With the outdoor temperature, Drying stands down when the outdoor air holds as much water as the room's (ventilating would bring more in).

create_replay.name: Create replay
create_replay.description: Builds an animated diagram from recorded history, so you can watch the recuperator breathe. The result appears in the Diagram replay image and is saved under /local/recuperator/, as an SVG and, if asked, a GIF. Values you give are remembered and used by the Create replay button; values left out use the saved ones.

config_entry_id.name: Recuperator
config_entry_id.description: Which recuperator. Needed when there is more than one.

hours.name: Hours
hours.description: How much history to replay, ending at End (or now). Left out: the saved value (default 24). Not together with Start.

start.name: Start
start.description: When the replay starts, instead of Hours: the replay runs from Start to End (or now), up to 31 days. Not saved.

end.name: End
end.description: When the replay ends (optional, default now).

playback_seconds.name: Playback length
playback_seconds.description: How long one loop of the animation lasts. Left out: the saved value (default 60).

frames.name: Frames
frames.description: Number of frames (0 = one per minute of history, 60 to 1440). Left out: the saved value.

include_linked.name: Include the synced recuperator
include_linked.description: With a synced recuperator: draw it too, under this one, on the same temperature scale. Left out: the saved value (default on).

gif.name: Also save a GIF
gif.description: Also save the replay as an animated GIF (<name>-replay.gif), which plays where an SVG does not, such as chats and e-mail. Takes a few seconds; at most 200 frames. Left out: the saved value (default off).
